description: The bar chart presents ratio percentages for three language models (Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT) across three topical categories to show how the reported ratio varies by model and category. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball” in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50% to 90% with evenly spaced tick marks every 10 percentage points. Each category displays a grouped set of three adjacent bars: Llama3 is shown in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow, as indicated by the legend centered above the plot. In “Movies,” the blue Llama3 bar is near 90%, the red Qwen2 bar is also around 90%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around the low 70s (approximately 73%). In “Songs,” the blue Llama3 bar is in the mid-80s (about 84%), the red Qwen2 bar is near 90%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is a little above 60% (about 62–63%). In “Basketball,” the blue Llama3 bar is in the mid-to-high 60s (about 66–67%), the red Qwen2 bar is just under 60% (about 57–58%), and the yellow ChatGPT bar is a little above 60% (about 61–62%). The bars are not visually sorted by height, and there are no special annotations or emphasized bars beyond the consistent color coding and grouping.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the ratio percentages of three models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three categories: 'Movies', 'Songs', and 'Basketball'. The X-axis contains the categories labeled as Movies, Songs, and Basketball, while the Y-axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with tick intervals of 10%. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 consistently exceeded ChatGPT, with Llama3 reaching approximately 95% and Qwen2 slightly below at 92%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 demonstrated a significant decline compared to Llama3, with Qwen2 at approximately 75% and Llama3 at 90%. In the Basketball category, ChatGPT showed the highest ratio at approximately 70%, followed by Llama3 at 65% and Qwen2 at 60%. The legend at the top center identifies the models corresponding to each bar color: blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT.
